Can FootPrint coordinate these ML steps?

We put model training, validation and release into FootPrint stages, with numerical work delegated.

Learned
We needed to follow the trained model through validation to the actual release choice.

FOOTPRINT / ML · BEFORE THE STORY

Can FootPrint’s flowchart pattern work in ML?

Training changes the numbers a model uses to predict. Validation checks those predictions on separate examples. A release chooses which model an application will use.

We tested model changes, held-out data, restart and release. We also checked inference—using a trained model to predict—to see whether a worker actually used its approved model.

The ML trainer

Learns and predicts

Rust, scikit-learn or JAX holds the arrays and computes updates and predictions.

FootPrint + ML layer

Tracks what changed

Stages pass model references and validation results. Explicit guards check data, selection and the checkpoint handed to a publisher.

Lens + foottrace

Explains the saved run

Inspect which model changed, what validated it, and how a release or retry was decided.

Next experiment→Growing graph→What we have now

Each slide names the ML task, the failure risk, what ran, the observed result and the next test.
